verdict.rationale: Gide has its own IT, Digital & Cybersecurity practice page and a Data Protection page that documents regulator-facing work, including CNIL sanctions proceedings. Neither page excerpt explicitly describes security-incident or breach response, so only the regulator-facing part of the story is clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit breach/incident-response service description, breach-notification handling with the CNIL or other regulators, incident-response matter references, independent corroboration.
